latest_delivery.message:
Target 2 and Target 5 have critical missing requirements that block completion:

**Target 2 - Missing Conversion Methods (pkg/endpoint)**:
The requirement explicitly states:
- `(mw UnaryMiddleware) ToMiddleware() Middleware` — converts UnaryMiddleware to Middleware
- `(mw Middleware) ToUnaryMiddleware() UnaryMiddleware` — converts Middleware to UnaryMiddleware

These conversion methods are ABSENT from endpoint.go. Verified by grep - no ToMiddleware or ToUnaryMiddleware methods exist.

**Target 5 - Incorrect File Structure (client/)**:
The requirement specifies FOUR separate files:
- client/option.go (type aliases + TailOption)
- client/option_unary.go (WithUnaryOptions, WithUnaryRPCTimeout, etc.)
- client/option_stream.go (WithStreamOptions, WithStreamRecvTimeout, etc.)
- client/option_ttstream.go (WithTTHeaderStreamingOptions, etc.)

Current implementation has only ONE file: client/option_categories.go
Verified: option_unary.go, option_stream.go, option_ttstream.go DO NOT EXIST.

Additionally missing:
- Type aliases in client/option.go (UnaryOption, StreamOption, TTHeaderStreamingOption, etc.)
- TailOption function in client/option.go
- client/callopt/streamcall/WithRecvTimeout function (verified missing)

These are structural requirements, not implementation suggestions. The file organization and conversion methods must match the specification before completion can be claimed.
